map.输入温度、降水、有效积温，结合作物生育期需求，给出播种、收割、灌溉等农事建议。: Enter temperature, precipitation and effective accumulated temperature, and combining the crop growth-stage requirements, get advice on sowing, harvesting, irrigation and other farm operations.
map.农业气象建议基于作物积温：生育进度=累积 GDD÷该作物所需 GDD 上限×10: Agrometeorological advice is based on crop GDD: growth progress = accumulated GDD ÷ the crop's upper GDD requirement ×100, dividing stages such as sowing-emergence / seedling-tillering / jointing-heading / filling-boll / maturity; sowing suitability is judged by temperature T against the crop's sowing temperature range [sowT] and optimum range [optT]; precipitation P<10 mm indicates irrigation is needed, and harvest and waterlogging advice is given by growth stage and precipitation.
map.已积累有效积温 GDD (°C·d): Accumulated effective growing degree days GDD (°C·d)
map.💡 有效积温 = Σ(日均温 - 生物学下限温度)，下限温度一般取 10°C；生: 💡 Effective accumulated temperature = Σ(daily mean temperature − biological base temperature), with the base temperature usually taken as 10°C; growth progress = accumulated GDD / GDD required for maturity ×100%.
map.积温阈值为常见品种参考值，不同熟期品种需求有差异: The GDD thresholds are reference values for common varieties; varieties with different maturity periods have different requirements
map.降水评估以周降水为尺度，实际需结合土壤墒情: Precipitation is assessed on a weekly scale; in practice it must be combined with soil moisture
map.建议为气象条件经验判断，具体农事请咨询当地农技部门: Advice is an empirical judgment based on weather conditions; for specific farm operations please consult your local agricultural technology department
map.由墒情、气温、降水给灌溉/播种/喷药建议。: Give irrigation/sowing/spraying advice from soil moisture, temperature and precipitation.
map.霜冻、干热风预警与防御。: Warning and defense against frost and dry hot wind.
map.农事日历按积温与降水安排。: Arrange the farming calendar by GDD and precipitation.
map.10cm 土壤湿度 12%（偏干）+ 预报 7 天无雨 + 气温偏高 → 建议灌: 10cm soil moisture 12% (on the dry side) + no rain forecast for 7 days + above-normal temperature → recommend irrigating 30-40 mm and mulching to preserve moisture.
map.凌晨最低气温预报 1°C、作物耐−1°C → 临界，建议熏烟/喷灌增温防轻霜冻。: Predawn minimum temperature forecast 1°C, crop tolerates −1°C → critical; recommend smoke or sprinkler irrigation to raise temperature and prevent light frost.
map.土壤湿度多少算旱？: What soil moisture counts as drought?
map.因作物与质地异，常见田间持水量 60% 以下需关注、40% 以下受旱，沙土阈值更: It varies with crop and soil texture; commonly below 60% of field capacity needs attention and below 40% is drought-stressed, with sandy soil having lower thresholds.
map.喷药看风还是看雨？: For spraying, watch wind or rain?
map.都看：风速>4 m/s 飘移、雨前 6h 内打药被冲，宜选静风无雨时段。: Both: wind above 4 m/s causes drift and rain within 6 hours of spraying washes it off, so choose a calm, rain-free period.
map.输入温度、降水和有效积温，结合玉米、水稻、小麦、棉花等作物的生育期积温需求，计算: Enter temperature, precipitation and effective accumulated temperature; combining the GDD requirements of crops such as maize, rice, wheat and cotton, it computes growth progress and gives advice on sowing suitability, harvest timing and irrigation/drainage.
map.多作物积温生育进度: GDD growth progress for multiple crops
